one_liner: TriggerZone sends a Discord message when a player walks through a configurable trigger zone, with an optional visual cube.
primary_use_case: Notify Discord channels of in‑world player actions via a trigger zone.
preview_recommendation: Add a screenshot or short video showing the trigger cube in the world and the Discord message that is posted when a player enters.
manifest_quality_notes: No preview media attached (flagged as no_media_found).
Webhook URL is empty by default; user must configure it.
Potential size mismatch if app.scale is changed after init.
Limited error handling for failed Discord requests.
Excluded names list may be case‑sensitive if not trimmed correctly.
